explanation: Formalizes that Borsuk's conjecture fails somewhere in the formerly open range 4 ≤ n ≤ 62, which follows from the claimed 9-dimensional counterexample. BorsukConjecture n correctly encodes "every bounded set with ≥ 2 points is covered by n + 1 sets of smaller diameter". Covers rather than partitions are equivalent, since subsets have smaller diameter. The statement is well formed. The solved status rests on OpenAI's 2026 counterexample (rank-one projectors on ℝ⁴ inside the 9-dimensional affine space of trace-one symmetric matrices), which I did not verify.
